scope: Zero-argument getWidthDiff/getHeightDiff on ordinary typed numeric SdkLatLngBounds with value, null or undefined corners, including all representable double values and raw numeric states. JS numeric constructor normalization then IEEE-754 subtraction is source-traced; absent-corner TypeError maps to SdkBoundsMissingCornerException. Numeric strings/coercion, custom getters, subclass/prototype mutation, listener state, and live mutable corner aliases are excluded.
review: Method-level typed adaptation is source-justified over the typed numeric/presence domain: SDK corner getters normalize via LatLng constructor, expose doubles then subtract; Dart getters clone/fromSdk with matching normalization and subtract in the same operand order. Runtime observations are corroborating examples, not an exhaustive input claim. Three-platform comparisons and strict source binding remain mandatory.

dimensions.inputs-defaults: SDK zero-argument bodies and Dart public zero-argument bindings; nine null/undefined/value combinations plus selected raw numeric samples.
dimensions.returns-types: JS Number and Dart double: finite values including signed zero use matching IEEE-754 subtraction after getter normalization, nonfinite inputs normalize through constructors, and overflow remains numeric. Exact sampled special-value tags corroborate source trace.
dimensions.mutation-identity: Methods use reads, fresh corner clones and primitive return values; before/after corner state compared for all 22 cases. No assertion of native live-corner alias identity.
dimensions.errors: For missing typed corners, the native getter raises TypeError at first missing access and Dart raises SdkBoundsMissingCornerException in the corresponding getter; exception identity/text differs intentionally.
dimensions.lifecycle-events: Pinned method/callee bodies and Dart bindings do not explicitly dispatch events or callbacks on ordinary instances; listener machinery and monkeypatching excluded.
dimensions.dispatch: The pinned public Tmapv3.LatLngBounds alias and prototype methods are checked; platform helper invokes getWidthDiff/getHeightDiff directly. Custom getter, subclass and prototype overrides are excluded.

methods.unit: signed degrees east minus west; getters apply SDK coordinate normalization
methods.limits: Source-proven numeric getter normalization and same-order IEEE-754 subtraction within the stated typed domain; no JS coercion, user overrides or live alias equivalence.
